source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the skin's defence (PDF 170-171).

blocks.text: Jild, jism ki sab se bairooni teh, jaraseem ke khilaf pehla difa deti hai. Is ki epidermis 10 se 30 cells moti hai. Bairooni teh, stratum corneum, musalsal zakhmi ho kar jharti hai; epidermis mein gehre bane naye cells oopar aa kar un ki jagah lete hain, aur yeh cells keratin banate hain jo jild ko sakht aur jaraseem ke liye na-qabil-e-guzar banata hai.

blocks.alt: Jild ka aik tukra kaat kar. Sab se oopar stratum corneum epidermis ka hissa hai. Neeche dermis hai jis mein baal apni thailiyon mein, tel ka ghudood, asab (nerve), khoon ki naliyan aur lipta hua paseene ka ghudood hai jis ki nali pore par khulti hai; sab se neeche charbi (adipose tissue) wali hypodermis. Brackets epidermis, dermis aur hypodermis dikhate hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.2: Jild ki tehein (kitab ki Figure 21.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Labels: Hair, Pores, Stratum corneum, Epidermis, Oil gland, Nerve, Dermis, Sweat gland, Blood vessels, Hair bulb, Adipose tissue, Hypodermis.

blocks.text: Jild kimiyai maaddon se bhi difa karti hai: tel aur paseene ke ghudood satah ka pH 3-5 tak kam karte hain jo bohat se jaraseem ki afzaish rokne ke liye kaafi tezaabi hai, aur paseene mein enzyme lysozyme hai jo bohat se bacteria ki cell walls par hamla kar ke hazam karta hai.

blocks.title: Maloomat
blocks.text: Jild vertebrate jism ka sab se bara uzv hai; baaligh insan mein yeh kul wazan ka taqreeban 15% hai. Kitab ke mutabiq insani jild ke aik murabba centimetre mein 200 asaab ke sire, 10 baal aur muscles, 100 paseene ke ghudood, 15 tel ke ghudood, 3 khoon ki naliyan, 12 garmi ke receptors, 2 sardi ke receptors aur 25 dabao ke receptors hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Jild jaraseem ko bahar rakhne ke do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: Koi do: musalsal jharne wali sakht keratin ki teh; tel aur paseene se tezaabi satah (pH 3-5); paseene ka lysozyme jo bacteria ki walls hazam karta hai.

items: Epidermis 10-30 cells; jharti stratum corneum; keratin jild sakht karta.
Tezaabi satah (pH 3-5) aur paseene mein lysozyme.
